idea-plugin.name: FeignClient Assistant With RequestX
idea-plugin.description:
FeignClient Assistant With RequestX is a free IntelliJ IDEA plugin for SpringCloud OpenFeign. It enables bidirectional cross-module navigation between FeignClient interfaces and remote service ApiController classes, parses server.servlet.context-path and spring.mvc.servlet.path from yml/yaml/properties configuration files, and supports one-click URL path copying to the clipboard. Former name: FeignX / Navigator4URL OpenFeign RestController.

GitHub Star | Issues | Pull Request
Features:
1. Inspired by MybatisX and method-level navigation gutter `bird`, it can flexibly jump back and forth between FeignClient and remote service ApiController cross-module. eg. feignClient -> ApiController && ApiController -> feignClient.
2. It supports `server.servlet.context-path` and `spring.mvc.servlet.path` by parsing yml/yaml/properties.
3. It is sufficiently accurate with options, after many rounds of optimization.
4. It supports real-time dynamic parsing of the target interface without the need for manual cache refreshing.
5. It provides a right-side `FeignClient Assistant With RequestX Endpoints` tool window listing all SpringBoot startup classes, SpringMVC and OpenFeign endpoints in a tree (grouped by type with distinct icons), featuring fuzzy path search, HttpType/EndpointType filters, refresh, and expand/collapse-all buttons.
6. It lets you send real HTTP requests right inside the endpoints tool window: select a request node to auto-generate an editable IntelliJ HTTP Client script (with `@RequestBody` / `@RequestParam` / `@PathVariable` support), execute it with one click and inspect the response, plus a request history (saved to the project's `.idea/feignx-history`, searchable and one-click reloadable).

中文简介: FeignClient Assistant With RequestX 是一款免费的 SpringCloud Feign 以及 HTTP 请求导航与脚本助手。
1. 受 `MybatisX` 和方法级导航侧边栏 `bird` 的启发，它可以在 FeignClient 与远程服务的 ApiController 之间灵活地跨模块来回跳转。例如 feignClient -> ApiController 且 ApiController -> feignClient。
2. 它通过解析 `yml/yaml/properties` 文件来支持 `server.servlet.context-path` 和 `spring.mvc.servlet.path`。
3. 经过多轮优化后，目标端点候选项已具有足够的准确性。
4. 它支持对目标接口进行实时动态解析，无需手动刷新缓存。
5. 它提供右侧 `FeignClient Assistant With RequestX Endpoints` 端点侧边栏，以树形结构集中展示工程内全部 SpringBoot 启动类、SpringMVC 与 OpenFeign 端点（按类型分组、图标区分），支持路径模糊搜索、HttpType/EndpointType 分类过滤、刷新与全部展开/收起。
6. 它支持在端点侧边栏内发送真实 HTTP 请求：选中请求节点自动生成可编辑的 IntelliJ HTTP Client 脚本（兼容 `@RequestBody` / `@RequestParam` / `@PathVariable`），一键执行并展示响应，同时记录请求历史（保存到工程 `.idea/feignx-history`，支持搜索与一键回填）。
